sources.title: Country policy and information note: sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, June 2025 (accessible) - GOV.UK
sources.claim_summary: UK Home Office country policy and information note: sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, June 2025 (v2.0, updated 12 Aug 2026). Asylum assessment: LGBT+ people form a refugee-convention social group; same-sex activity not criminalised but same-sex marriage and gender transition are banned (2023 law); in general no real risk of state persecution except in the North Caucasus, for trans people, and for publicly active individuals. Full 210k-char guidance document with country information and methodology sections.

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (JavaScript shell, 725 chars); the underlying source is the US State Department's travel advisory for this country - Level 4, do not travel, for all travellers regardless of personal characteristic (wrongful detention, active war, arbitrary law enforcement).

sources.title: Russia: Rising Toll of LGBT ‘Extremism’ Designation | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch report (30 June 2025): courts have issued 101 'extremism' convictions for alleged participation in the 'International LGBT Movement' or displaying its symbols - approximately 98 administrative and 3 criminal - following the Supreme Court's November 2023 designation of the movement as extremist (effective January 2024); cites the 2013 'gay propaganda' administrative-offence law as precedent.
